5b. ¿Qué días y cuántas horas le dedicó... a su trabajo la semana pasada?
9. Durante la semana pasada, ¿cuánto tiempo dedicó... a

assessments.reasoning: For economic_maintenance: False. Although Question 6b in the Cuestionario de Ocupación y Empleo captures individual labor earnings, the supplied instruments do not capture non-labor income sources (such as pensions, remittances, or transfers) across all sources at the individual member level. For labor_burden: True. The Cuestionario de Ocupación y Empleo collects individual member-level time spent in paid employment (Question 5b) as well as unpaid domestic and care work (Question 9, including childcare, eldercare, housework, and household errands). For property_asset_control: False. The instruments do not contain questions on dwelling tenure or asset/property ownership by household member. For decision_making: False. Neither questionnaire includes questions regarding intra-household decision-making spheres.
